title: Account Manager - Digital Marketing
description:
Account Manager Digital Marketing

Location: Hybrid with 2 days per week in our Altrincham office
Salary: £35,000 to £40,000 dependent on experience
Contract: Full time, Permanent

Dark Horse is a renowned digital marketing agency based in Altrincham, specialising in PPC, Paid Social, SEO and Digital PR. With a diverse clientele and a commitment to delivering exceptional results.

We re after someone who cannot stand a missed deadline, takes pride in keeping every account on track, and genuinely gives a toss about clients getting the results they were promised.

This is a hybrid role based in Altrincham. No remote applications.

What s on offer

We think we ve built a great place to work, where every individual feels rewarded for the effort they put in.
- Salary of £35,000 to £40,000 DOE
- Hybrid working - 2 days a week in office
- Flexitime
- 27 days annual leave
- Plus your Birthday off
- Mental Wellbeing Bupa EAP programme
- Leafy Altrincham location
- Dark Horse will carbon offset your role with The Dark Forest
- Working in an amazing team with many fantastic people

The role

Reporting directly to the Head of Client Services and giving them a clear view of where your accounts stand. Our Service Leads own the day-to-day client conversations and channel strategy.

You are the one making sure the results are making a tangible impact; monitoring every KPI, keeping our health scoring and check-in cadence running like clockwork, and making sure nothing ever slips between us and the client.

This is a client guardianship and relationship role, not project management or day-to-day contact.

Throughout each month you will:
- Work with the Service Leads to monitor performance against KPIs across 40 accounts
- Pressure-test our monthly reports vs KPIs, coordinating feedback across channel specialists
- Spot channel specific comms and changes that affect other areas and make sure no-one is working in a silo
- Ensure all accounts get timely performance reviews, QBRs, prebreak and pre-renewal reviews
- Maintain accurate client health scores in (url removed)
- Spot amber and red movement before it becomes a problem and escalate fast
- Support renewals and cross-sell execution (materials, follow-up) without owning the commercial strategy or pricing

In order to be successful in this role you must have / be:
- Capable of having mature commercial conversations with business owners
- Experience in client services or account management, ideally in a performance or digital marketing agency
- Calm and organised managing a high volume of accounts (40-50 contracts)
- A confident, clear and humble communicator, written and verbal
- Comfortable asking and answering the hard commercial questions with senior client stakeholders
- Data-literate: you read performance metrics (CPA, spend, conversions) and understand the commercial story behind them

It would be great if you had:
- Hands-on exposure to PPC, Paid Social, SEO or Digital PR
- Experience working alongside specialist delivery teams
- Familiarity with (url removed) and with health-scoring or account tiering frameworks

This is a hybrid role based in Altrincham. No remote applications.

If you feel you have the necessary skills and experience to be successful in this role click on APPLY !
